cues.en: These are the latest pictures from the Mars probe, NASA's most recent triumph in space.
cues.zh: 这是火星探测器传回的最新画面，也是 NASA 在太空探索中的最新胜利。

cues.en: The Mercury project, the Apollo missions, and the Mars probe. Now NASA embarks on its most daring and exciting project yet. Thank you very much. We have an announcement to make on
cues.zh: 从水星计划、阿波罗任务，到火星探测器。如今 NASA 将启动迄今最大胆、最令人激动的项目。非常感谢。我们有一项声明要发布，就在

cues.en: July fourth of this year. America
cues.zh: 今年的七月四日。美国

cues.en: will blow up the moon.
cues.zh: 将炸毁月球。

cues.en: We have the technology.
cues.zh: 我们拥有这项技术。

cues.en: The time is now. Science can wait no longer. Children are our future.
cues.zh: 时机已到。科学已刻不容缓。孩子是我们的未来。

cues.en: America can, should, must, and will blow up the moon. Yes. And we'll be doing it during a full moon, so we make sure we get it all.
cues.zh: 美国能够、应当、必须、也一定会炸掉月球。没错。而且我们要在满月时动手，确保炸得干干净净。

cues.en: Blowing up the moon fever has gripped the entire country, including the president himself,
cues.zh: 炸月球热潮席卷全国，连总统本人也为之着迷，

cues.en: Guy Whitey Corngood. Let's do this.
cues.zh: Guy Whitey Corngood。干起来吧。

cues.en: We are just ecstatic, our whole family. We're gonna have a party and watch the moon blow up.
cues.zh: 我们全家都欣喜若狂。我们要办个派对，看月球被炸掉。

cues.en: I'm gonna bake a cake in the shape of the moon blowing up.
cues.zh: 我要烤一个月球爆炸形状的蛋糕。

cues.en: No more moon. When
cues.zh: 月亮已经不存在了。当

cues.en: I was a boy,
cues.zh: 我还是个男孩的时候，

cues.en: blowing up the moon was just a beautiful dream.
cues.zh: 炸掉月亮只是个美好的梦想。

cues.en: Now it's science fact.
cues.zh: 如今，这成了科学事实。

cues.en: This is the moon blowing up, and this is me smiling.
cues.zh: 这是月亮爆炸的画面，这是笑着的我。

cues.en: Moon America's
cues.zh: 月球美国的

cues.en: gonna get you. Gotta go. Kaboom was nice to adventure because you don't mess around
cues.zh: 要来抓你了。得走了。卡布姆上路冒险挺不错的，因为你可别在

cues.en: with God's America.
cues.zh: 上帝的美国乱来。

cues.en: Well, I've been saying we should do this for years. I walked on the moon. I did
cues.zh: 嗯，我多年来一直说我们该这么干。我在月球上走过。我还

cues.en: a push up, ate an egg on it.
cues.zh: 在上面做了个俯卧撑，吃了个鸡蛋。

cues.en: What else can you do with it?
cues.zh: 你还能拿它做什么？

cues.en: Exploder one will carry enough dynamite and nuclear charges to blow up the moon 50 times over. The president himself will announce the rocket's countdown. Get ready!
cues.zh: Exploder One 将携带足够把月球炸毁 50 次的炸药和核弹头。总统将亲自宣布火箭倒计时。做好准备！

cues.en: Once the ship is in space, Galileo,
cues.zh: 一旦飞船进入太空，伽利略——

cues.en: the great grandson of Ulysses, the first monkey to travel in space, will push the launch button.
cues.zh: 也就是第一只进入太空的猴子 Ulysses 的曾孙，将按下发射按钮。

cues.en: And Grace Flitz, the Olympic gold medal high diver, will do a difficult triple aerial pike to signal that the mission has been a success. We're ahead of schedule,
cues.zh: 而奥运高台跳水金牌得主 Grace Flitz 将完成一个高难度的空中屈体三周跳，以此示意任务圆满成功。我们目前进度超前，

cues.en: way ahead of schedule. Oh, we're having fun. Ken here is talking to Galileo,
cues.zh: 大大超前了。哈哈，大家都干劲十足。Ken 这会儿正在和伽利略交流呢，

cues.en: the monkey knows sign language.
cues.zh: 这只猴子还懂手语。

cues.en: And when we...
cues.zh: 而我们…

cues.en: What? What's funny? Galileo just asked why. He said, why are you blowing up the moon? Yeah.
cues.zh: 什么？有什么好笑的？伽利略刚问为什么。他说，你为什么要炸掉月球？是啊。

cues.en: Controversy and America reacts. Monkey sure took the fun out of everything. Yeah. We had this whole party planned. Well, there isn't gonna be any party now.
cues.zh: 争议四起，美国民众反应强烈。猴子真是把一切都弄得没趣了。是啊，我们本来都计划好整场派对了。唉，现在不会有任何派对了。

cues.en: Hey, mister monkey. Don't be asking why. Don't you know you can't mess with
cues.zh: 嘿，猴子先生。别问为什么。你难道不知道你不能乱碰

cues.en: American pride.
cues.zh: 美国的骄傲。

cues.en: We think the monkey's a 100% right. We're spending so much money, millions of dollars to blow up the moon when there's so much right here on earth to blow up. Mount Everest, the North Pole,
cues.zh: 我们认为猴子百分之百说得对。我们花那么多钱，数百万美元去炸月球，而地球上明明有那么多东西可以炸。珠穆朗玛峰、北极，

cues.en: etcetera. We're earthlings. Let's blow up earth things.
cues.zh: 等等。我们是地球人。咱们就炸地球上的东西吧。

cues.en: We're earthlings. Let's blow blow up up earth earth things. Things. When all seems lost, the country's top minds come up with a last minute solution. We are replacing Galileo the monkey with mister Wiggles the monkey.
cues.zh: 我们都是地球人。咱们来炸炸地球地球人。人。当一切似乎都无望时，全国最顶尖的头脑在最后一刻想出了办法。我们要用小猴先生 Wiggles 替换猴子 Galileo。

cues.en: Mister Wiggles comes to us from the circus. He does tricks and most importantly,
cues.zh: 小猴先生 Wiggles 来自马戏团。他会表演杂技，最重要的是，

cues.en: he doesn't know any sign language.
cues.zh: 他不懂任何手语。

cues.en: He'll do the job, no questions asked.
cues.zh: 交给他准没错，他不会问东问西。

cues.en: Tonight, we will blow up the moon.
cues.zh: 今晚，我们要炸掉月球。

cues.en: Hey, they did it, sir. What?
cues.zh: 长官，他们做到了。什么？

cues.en: They blew up the moon. Is that an idea?
cues.zh: 他们把月球炸了。这算是个主意吗？
